Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review - request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week - the Aurora infrastructure team wanted to follow up and schedule a technical deep-dive specifically around Redwood Dedicated capacity: pool sizing, autoscaling behaviour, and tenant isolation. We'll need to include our infra lead (Ethan) and the cloud procurement PM.

Rough agenda they'd like to cover (30-45m):
- Current throughput targets and P99 latency expectations
- Pool sizing math for mixed batch/interactive workloads
- Autoscaling policies and burst capacity behavior
- Security/isolation model and multi-tenant options
- Operational handoffs and monitoring (tracing/token-level cost)

Are you available next week? We prefer morning PT slots. If possible, can you also share any existing capacity draft or topology doc ahead of the call?

Thanks,

Aurora HealthTech
